name: Shirosaki Rio
source:
He works as a host.
He's boastful and has a lot of pride but he's an optimist that likes to do fun things.
He's basically kind to everyone but he has no forgiveness for people that he may come to hate.
He's good at persuading people with words, but even more than that his forte is captivating women with hugs and other escort actions.
He likes manga, anime, net games and other otaku type things.
His flower is the Cattleya.

He likes manga, anime, net games and other otaku type things.
